name: Clang C/C++ Context Indexing
purpose: Build and query code-context indexes for C/C++ repositories using Clang libclang and clangd: compilation-database-driven symbol extraction, incremental reindexing on header-closure changes, and a ranked symbol/reference/call-graph query API for AI agents.
inputs: Repository root, source globs, and Clang version (17 or newer)
compile_commands.json compilation database or the build command that generates it
Token budget caps for query answers (max symbols and max tokens)
Golden symbol set with expected definitions and references
outputs: Queryable SQLite symbols database with definition, reference, and call-graph lookup
stop_conditions: Golden symbol recall reaches 100% with query p95 under 250 ms on a warm index
Incremental reindex of a single dirty translation unit completes in under 5 seconds
